title: Before the latest update this was a decent app.
text:
I have been working with this app for quite some time, and I was really satisfied with the result. This changed with the fall 2025 update. The “recreate” option was taken out of the app, because AI recreation of a severely damaged image is now supposedly achieved by using the “colorize” button. The results this app produces now are simply horrible, and subscribing to this downgraded version of a formerly really good photo restoration app is really not worth it anymore. Due to the significantly worse restoration results I am seeing  since the update, I will cancel my subscription  for this now qualitative substandard app. 
This is really disappointing, but luckily there are competitors out there that now by far outperform this merely mediocre app. While I recommended this app before, I now recommend to possible future subscribers to find a better quality app and not waste their money on this one.
